verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to configure automations that run on their own in the background, such as scheduled or event-triggered jobs. 'Fix with v0', 'Fix Build' and 'Fix CI' are one-off actions the user starts from a menu, not recurring or autonomous automations. The v0 API/SDK is a developer building block that could be used to build such automation, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
